prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Impeccable visual-direction card for a desktop React product workspace
Primary request: Create exactly one landscape 16:9 flat matte unfinished UI design sketch titled “Structural Drawing Assistant” for the “Evidence Light Table” direction. It is a desktop production workspace for quantity surveyors who repeatedly review hundreds of beam and column records extracted from construction PDFs, resolve AI ambiguities through linked source evidence, edit dimensions, and export.
Scene/backdrop: The entire frame is the product interface itself, viewed straight-on, with a cool-white illuminated drafting surface and translucent construction drawing overlays.
Subject: A dominant architectural plan / PDF evidence plane occupies most of the viewport. A narrow indexed beam-and-column member register runs down the left edge. One beam on the plan is actively highlighted with a single amber locator. Compact editable dimension controls are attached spatially to that selected beam rather than placed in a separate form. A contextual decision strip docks along the bottom immediately beneath the highlighted evidence, showing evidence resolution choices and an export/action zone through abstract controls.
Style/medium: Flat matte concept-design sketch, deliberately unfinished but highly art-directed, precise 2D UI drawing, subtle drafting-paper grain, translucent vellum overlays, fine technical ink lines, no photorealism, no glossy render, no device frame.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, edge-to-edge desktop viewport, same confident framing as a premium design direction card. Strong asymmetry: approximately 18% narrow register at left, the broad evidence light table across the remaining field, low bottom decision strip. Do not use three equal columns or a generic dashboard grid.
Lighting/mood: Cool-white internally illuminated light-table feeling, calm, rigorous, workhorse, evidence-first.
Color palette: Cool white, charcoal/navy ink, pale vellum blue-gray, restrained red grease-pencil only for unresolved or changed marks, exactly one amber active locator.
Materials/textures: Matte drafting paper and translucent vellum; fine pencil/ink construction marks; restrained grease-pencil annotations.
Typography: Workhorse humanist sans with tabular numerals. The only legible text anywhere is “Structural Drawing Assistant”. Render every other label, number, dimension, table entry, button, annotation, and PDF callout as indistinct greeking, bars, ticks, or unreadable microtype.
Text (verbatim): “Structural Drawing Assistant”
Constraints: Make evidence linkage immediately visually obvious between the selected register row, highlighted beam, attached dimensions, and bottom resolution strip. Suggest hundreds of records through dense indexing without readable data. No factual claims. Avoid conversational UI.
Avoid: generic three-panel layout, equal cards, floating card grid, rounded SaaS dashboard, chat panel, chatbot, oversized headings, legible secondary text, photorealism, gloss, glassmorphism, neon, gradients, stock imagery, people, construction-site photography, laptop or browser chrome, logos, watermarks.
